articleTitle: Research on the Design of Digital Twin System for Construction Safety
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the development of information technology, safety management in the construction field urgently needs to be upgraded digitally and intelligently. Construction-oriented digital twin technology can improve the efficiency and safety of site management. Designing a construction-oriented digital twin system is a complex process, requiring the design of the modules that implement the digital twin to ensure system viability. Furthermore, it is necessary to design system functions and interactions according to user needs to ensure the humanization of the system. This paper starts from these two aspects, theoretically builds the construction-oriented digital twin module, preliminarily designs the system prototype, and experimentally tests its usability. The innovations of this paper include the following points: 1. Combine digital twin technology with infrastructure construction safety management; 2. Gain insight into the pain points and needs of safety officers to study the design principles and specifications of digital twin technology in new scenarios; 3. Explore the UX (User Experience) design of the interactive interface of the digital twin system. The research results of this paper have reference value for the practice of digital twin interaction design.

articleTitle: Task Offload Optimization Management of Networked Vehicles in Edge Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the continuous development of 5G technology and intelligent technology, intelligent networked vehicles can rely on vehicle-road collaboration technology to form a more specific understanding of traffic situations through edge caching and edge computing services of roadside infrastructure to ensure driving safety. Improve traffic efficiency. The main purpose of this paper is to study the task offloading optimization management of connected vehicles based on edge computing. While constructing the model for offloading computing tasks, this paper uses python programming simulation to implement. Python language has a powerful standard library, and it also provides a large number of application modules, which users can directly call according to their own needs. application. Python language can be mature and widely used in website data crawling, data operation, image system, and Web system development. In this paper, a computing offloading process is divided into two parts, namely code migration and data offloading. The code only contains the general computing code file of the task (that is, the OpenCL kernel program file) and the AI computing code file (that is, the TensorFlow model file).) and a task configuration script file with the input data to be processed by the task. Moreover, the runtime environment of application tasks is pre-arranged on each device, regardless of online deployment or offloading, which greatly reduces the amount of transmitted data.

articleTitle: Research on Fire Performance Test Technology of Electric Vehicle Power Battery System
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the rapid development of the electric vehicle industry, power lithium-ion battery fires are frequently occurring. Relevant personnel have found that thermal runaway of internal power lithium-ion batteries is the root cause of electric vehicle fires. This paper designs an electric vehicle safety early warning system from the perspective of electric vehicle battery safety using cloud computing technology and electric vehicle terminal. In this paper, the on-board terminal is used to realize all-round monitoring of electric vehicle batteries, data cloud synchronization, and high-performance data distribution on the cloud server through cloud computing technology, so as to realize early accident warning, condition maintenance and all-field battery tracking for electric vehicles. At the same time, this paper takes the pure electric vehicle equipped with lithium-ion power battery as the research object. We design the whole vehicle test plan according to the causes of thermal diffusion of the power battery. The research results show that the thermal runaway process of the battery all go through the heat storage stage, the exhaust stage and the thermal runaway stage. We use the spring heating coil to induce the thermal runaway time of the battery at a temperature rise rate of 5 and 10 °C/min, respectively, which is 18.3% and 40.2% faster than that of the heating rod.

articleTitle: RSSI Indoor Location Based on Weighted KNN
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In recent years, positioning technology have been utilized more and more often. However, with the rapid development of IOT, there is an urgent need for high-precision prediction algorithms.. Comparing with outdoor positioning, indoor location requires much higher accuracy. And what's more is that indoor environment is much more complicated than outdoor environment, so the signals are easy to be affected. Both of the features of indoor positioning have give challenges for us to find proper algorithms to be utilize in the boosting IOT market. To address this issue, this paper compares three indoor positioning algorithms, which are Trilateration, KNN, as well as WKNN. Two different scenarios are set to demonstrate the impact of the size of the environment and the interference level on the accuracy of the prediction. And to make the result verified, this paper performs the experiment with three mainstream technologies, which are BLE, Zigbee and WIFI.

articleTitle: Evaluation for Warship Satellite Communication System
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The effectiveness of warship satellite communication system in complex electromagnetic environment is not only determined by the technical of the system itself, but also depends on the ability of communication commanders and operators. When constructing the evaluation index system, this paper brings the organization and command ability, emergency response ability, communication skills and operation ability of communication commanders and operators into the index system for the first time. Efficiency analysis is carried out by applying gray integrated evaluation means. Model construction is proved to be incredible and available, which provides a new idea for communication system effectiveness evaluation.

articleTitle: Analyse of Influence of Adversarial Samples on Neural Network Attacks with Different Complexities
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In latest years, neural networks have produced impressive text mining and computer vision achievements. The neural networks are becoming increasingly sophisticated and can perform many recognition tasks requiring accuracy. For example, VGG-16 has sixteen convolutional layers and fully connected layers, and the depth of the network can be increased by multiple non-linear layers to assure learning more intricate patterns. However, in real application scenarios, neural networks reveal problems such as poor resistance to interference. Researchers found that after designing the adversarial objects as normal objects with slight perturbation, the neural network models misclassify the images even though they have almost no effect on the human eye. A set of these adversarial objects produced by a particular attack and defense approach is referred to as an adversarial sample. The emergence of adversarial samples has seriously affected the development of artificial intelligence, and different neural networks have their own advantages and disadvantages in defending against adversarial samples, and no defense method has been found to completely defend against adversarial sample attacks. In this article, we look into the security issue of adversarial samples in the context of deep learning for image classification and test the resistance of several neural networks to the adversarial sample attack. The Fast Gradient Sign Attack technique (FGSM) is used in this study to produce adversarial samples for neural network assaults of varying complexity.

articleTitle: Research on Railway DevSecOps System Construction Based on “People-Process-Technology”
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the continuous development of railway business, the architecture of railway application software has become more and more complex, and the security threats faced by it have become increasingly severe. In order to repair the security vulnerabilities exposed by the application software, the railway software R&D enterprises have to respond passively after the software is put into operation and maintenance, which increases the cost in the software life cycle. Many organizations try to introduce the DevSecOps concept to shift software security to the left, so as to solve security problems in the R&D process, but pay more attention to relevant technical tools or processes. Based on the characteristics of railway enterprises, this research designed an enterprise R&D team structure, divided the technical tools supporting R&D into four domains, standardized the process system integrating safety detection and protection, formed a railway DevSecOps system based on “people-process-technology“, and achieved good results in the R&D practice of railway application software.

articleTitle: A Novel Modulation Recognition Algorithm for Satellite Communication and TT&C Signals
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Electromagnetic signal modulation mode is one of the key elements of battlefield technical parameter information. This paper proposes an efficient modulation recognition algorithm for satellite communication and TT&C signals based on decision tree, which can accurately identify eight satellite modulation modes, including BPSK, QPSK, 2FSK, 4FSK, 16QAM, BPSK/PM, QPSK/PM and 2FSK/PM. The spectrum characteristics of the modulation methods commonly used in satellite communication and TT&C signals are firstly analyzed, and the main differences between and within categories of modulation methods of satellite signals are summarized; Then, rational feature parameters are selected and designed, and a complete modulation recognition process is proposed based on these parameters; Finally, the correctness and performance of the proposed recognition algorithm are evaluated by numerical simulation. The simulation results show that when the SNR (signal-to-noise ratio) of the proposed algorithm is more than 4dB, the modulation recognition accuracy of the eight satellite communication/TT&C signals can reach above 95%.

articleTitle: PROFINET diagnosis and predictive maintenance
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper first provides a detailed introduction to PROFINET diagnostic data sources, diagnostic models, and the basic theory of diagnostic implementation, with the aim of helping PROFINET users understand the structure and transmission principles of diagnostic information. Then the integration architecture of PROFINET and OPC UA technology is proposed, and the various ways of transferring diagnostic information to manufacturing execution systems (device to PLC, device to edge devices, and device to MES/Cloud) are illustrated. Finally, the importance of PROFINET diagnostic information for predictive maintenance implementation is pointed out with examples.

articleTitle: Design and experiment of 200-500A/5A wide-range electromagnetic current transformer based on improved 1K107 material
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The measurement error caused by the large range of power load changes is relatively large. Therefore, the problem of economic loss is caused. In this paper, the wide-range current transformers with a rated primary current of 200-500A are designed. It can meet the accuracy requirement of 0.2S in the range of 0.1%~200% of the rated current. In order to achieve this goal, this paper firstly improves the traditional 1K107 material. The improved core material greatly improves the initial magnetic permeability, which can improve the measurement accuracy of small primary currents. Several prototypes were made and experiments were carried out. It was found that the designed wide-range current transformers met the accuracy requirements of 0.2S within the range of 0.1% to 200% of the rated current.

articleTitle: Design of Archives Management Information System Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: At present, the archives management of enterprises is facing great work pressure, mainly focusing on data sharing and information operation. This paper mainly studies the application of blockchain technology, and explores the feasibility of blockchain technology applied to archives management information system through system design and simulation system implementation. This paper studies the traditional file management system, analyzes the application of the traditional enterprise file management system, and uses the blockchain technology in the system. Based on the content research and technical innovation of blockchain technology application, the existing traditional enterprise archives management system in China is investigated. On this basis, the system design based on Bubi blockchain is proposed, and the four functional modules of the simulation system are designed and implemented. Finally, the archive information management system based on blockchain Technology is tested, and the implementation success rate can reach 100%, and the CPU occupancy rate does not exceed 70%, The average response time is less than 1s.

articleTitle: Simulation Study of Financial Securities Market Volatility Model Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the continuous development and improvement of financial markets, the study of the nature and laws of the stock market has put forward higher requirements, of which predicting stock market volatility has become an important financial topic. The volatility of the stock market is its essential feature and attribute, but if the price volatility shows a sharp amplitude and too fast frequency, it may lead to the price distortion of the market, and then lead to the violent stock market shocks. Neural network is a powerful and widely used machine learning algorithm that is very good at discovering nonlinear relationships between data and is suitable for stock price prediction problems. The paper takes into account the factors influencing stock prices, extracts trading indicators and financial indicators, reduces the dimensionality through principal component analysis, and uses the reduced-dimensional principal components as the input variables of the network. Based on the actual stock trading market, this paper establishes a multilayer neural network classifier and uses four learning algorithms in BP neural network to fit the simulated data, and the results show that the algorithm has high accuracy for volatility pattern recognition. Under the modern fierce market competition, enterprises must strengthen the control of corporate financial risks and financial crisis prevention if they want to survive, develop and make profits.

articleTitle: Research on Fast Seismic Intensity Evaluation Method Based on Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The rapid determination of earthquake intensity after an earthquake is of great significance for disaster relief and disaster reduction. The traditional earthquake intensity assessment is determined by on-site manual investigation, which usually takes a long time, and it often takes a longer time to complete the strong earthquake with a larger impact range. In this paper, we try to use computer method to replace manual work, that is, convolutional neural network (CNN) in depth learning. According to the characteristics of post earthquake building damage and the specifications of seismic intensity scale of Chinese earthquakes, we build a proper CNN model, train and test the model with marked data set samples, and build a rapid seismic intensity evaluation platform with high timeliness. Finally, this paper points out the problems of this method in the evaluation, and looks forward to the future research and application of fast seismic intensity evaluation method based on convolutional neural network.

articleTitle: Real Time Attrition Prediction Mechanism Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Modern companies mostly have their own employee management systems, which retain a large amount of employee behavior data. These data can be used to mine valuable information, such as whether employees have attrition intentions. This paper proposes a mechanism of attrition prediction based on deep learning, which mainly includes three modules: (1) Using LSTM to build a performance-attrition pre-trained model; (2)Using Transformer to build a sentiment tendency model based on employee weekly reports; (3) Based on (1), (2), establishing Real Time Attrition Prediction Mechanism in the company's employee management system to predict employees' willingness to leave at any time. The purpose of this mechanism is to help companies manage better and reduce losses caused by employee attrition.

articleTitle: Construction of Enterprise Economic Benefit Evaluation System Based on Fuzzy Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The formation of EEBE (Enterprise Economic Benefit Evaluation) index is an objective reflection of enterprise management practice. Therefore, the construction of evaluation index must follow strict procedures and methods, and can't be arbitrarily determined by subjective will and personal experience. This topic carries out the construction of EEBE system based on fuzzy clustering algorithm. The EEBE system design method based on FCM (Fuzzy C-means) establishes the corresponding evaluation factor set according to the characteristics of the evaluation object and the evaluation criteria learned from the demand analysis. Finally, the physical architecture of EEBE system is realized. According to the physical structure and actual situation of the system, it is planned to set up four database servers, and adopt dual-computer hot standby to ensure the stability and security of the system. Simulation results show that the accuracy of this algorithm is 15.308% higher than that of the traditional fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method. This method is more suitable for fast clustering, and the accuracy of clustering is largely determined by the first stage, and the second stage is to further optimize the clustering center.

Author Keywords: Evaluation of economic benefits of enterprises

articleTitle: Fire monitoring and management system based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In view of the shortcomings of the traditional building fire monitoring and alarm system, such as complicated wiring and difficult management, this paper designs a wireless fire monitoring and management system based on ZigBee and LabVIEW. Firstly, the overall structure of the monitoring and management system is introduced, and then the hardware design and software design of the system are introduced respectively, and a physical model is built to complete the system test. The upper computer monitoring interface can accurately monitor the temperature and humidity in the building in real time, and make an alarm when abnormal conditions are detected. The system can greatly reduce the wiring cost and building renovation cost in the fire monitoring system, and has important practical application value for building fire protection.

articleTitle: Research on Accident Risk Early Warning System Based on Railway Safety Management Data under Cloud Edge Collaborative Architecture
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: At present, the early warning and prediction of railway accidents are mostly carried out from the perspective of technical conditions, that is, the unsafe state of equipments, such as the degree of rail wear, the operation state of locomotive parts, etc. These analyses ignored the management factors behind the accident, such as the impact of people's unsafe behaviors on the accident. This research constructs an accident risk early warning system based on safety inspection data and establishes a corresponding relationship between massive safety inspection data and accident risk factors. In this study, the analysis model and mining algorithm are based on Heinrich's rule and the time decay factor of historical events, and the cloud edge collaboration method is adopted to give consideration to model training and application. Finally, the results of risk assessment are visualized through different forms of seaweed ball models, which is helpful for safety managers to master the risk situation. The above early warning system has been applied in some railway bureaus and achieved good application results.

articleTitle: Sequential Scheme of Full Composition Model for CO2 Flooding in Adaptive-Mesh System
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper implements a novel adaptive mesh methodology to sequential fully implicit method (SFI) of composition model for CO<inf>2</inf> flooding. Specific mesh upscaling and downscaling procedures are taken into account, so as to ensure continuity of physical quantities and conservation of pressure equations. Besides, a velocity-based reordering algorithm in adaptive-mesh system is proposed for saturation equations and mole fraction equations. Through a three-phase nine-component numerical case, the efficiency and the accuracy of this methodology have been verified.

articleTitle: Development and Design of Intelligent Control System for Full Performance Test
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The research and development of the intelligent management and control system of electric energy metering equipment replaces manual operation with standardized automatic operation, improves the consistency, standardization and reliability of the full performance test of metering equipment, and lays a solid foundation for the automation technology of energy metering equipment. The intelligent management and control system of the experiment realizes the flexible scheduling control strategy of the system, and uses data processing, storage, transmission and analysis technologies to realize information management and quality control. The full-performance intelligent management and control system completes the design and development of the intelligent management and control system for electric energy metering equipment through the design of the full-performance test items and detection process of the electric energy meter and the acquisition terminal. The test intelligent management and control system is compatible with the automatic connection and disconnection technology of various metering equipment, and realizes the automatic connection and disconnection of equipment and automatic testing.

articleTitle: Prediction of cost of power transmission and transformation project based on neural network
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In the face of the increasingly high cost of intelligent substations, it is necessary to strengthen the management and control of intelligent substation engineering cost within a reasonable range. To achieve the purpose of saving construction resources, reducing costs and increasing efficiency has become a key problem that must be solved at this stage. Currently, the engineering design and estimation process of power transmission and transformation projects lacks of the function of forecasting. In order to solve this problem, this paper establishes a neural network-based power transmission and transformation project cost prediction model, establishes a cost system, and uses the principal component analysis method to extract the main influencing factors of the power transmission and transformation project cost. Through testing and verification, the prediction results of the established model are more accurate, and it can reasonably predict the cost of power transmission and transformation projects.

articleTitle: Research on Monitoring Strategy of New Energy Vehicle Power System Based on the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Electric vehicles have become increasingly popular recently, and powertrain failures have caused more accidents. There are several problems that can arise from these accidents, including malfunctioning powertrain and spontaneous combustion. This requires complete monitoring procedures to prevent the problems mentioned above from occurring in an electric vehicle's power system. A new energy vehicle's power system monitoring measures are examined in this paper using the above background of the Internet of Things. As a result, the existing electric car power system characteristics are taken into account when formulating the corresponding power system and monitoring strategy scheme. Research is conducted on the characteristics of its database access and hardware composition.

articleTitle: Optimization of supply chain in iron and steel industry based on pre flow advancing network flow algorithm and computer simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Under the relatively mature background of the iron and steel industry, the focus of industrial optimization is focused on the optimization of the logistics supply chain. In this paper, a large amount of data is extracted from the preventive maintenance inspection of the iron and steel industry supply chain, and a model to improve the transportation efficiency and test the maximum production and transportation capacity is constructed. Using the pre-flow propulsion network flow algorithm to solve the problem at high speed, it aims to quickly solve the model target value under the dynamic and diverse conditions. Taking the simulated industry situation in Zhejiang as an example, the network transport flow model and method proposed in this paper are verified to solve the problem of supply chain optimization and calculation in the iron and steel industry.

articleTitle: Connected Vehicle Path Planning and Resource Allocation in Edge Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The great improvement of traffic conditions has changed people's travel modes, and it has also made it difficult for the existing road network structure to meet the growing demand for transportation. Therefore, in order to improve the quality of the network connection and road network, and alleviate the urban traffic congestion, new path planning methods need to be adopted. One of the most prominent is the shortest path in edge computing. This paper mainly uses the comparative analysis and experimental methods to analyze the role of edge computing in the path planning of connected vehicles, and describes the resource allocation. In the experimental results, when the number of populations reaches 240, the number of iterations of the edge detection algorithm reaches a minimum of 21.8. This shows that the algorithm has a fast convergence speed and is suitable for the preliminary path planning of connected vehicles.

articleTitle: Predicting Atmospheric Humidity Using Artificial Neural Networks and BeiDou Satellite Navigation Data
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Atmospheric humidity information is very important basic data in scientific research such as weather forecasting and climate change assessment. However, because there are many factors affecting atmospheric humidity, it is difficult to predict it, and there is less work. We found that the satellite data of the Beidou satellite navigation system can have a greater impact on the predicted atmospheric humidity. Therefore, this paper combines the current hot artificial intelligence and neural network algorithms and uses the data obtained from the Beidou satellite navigation system in Wuhan to train the network, so as to achieve the purpose of predicting the actual atmospheric humidity information. The prediction results show that the use of neural networks and BDS satellite data to predict atmospheric humidity can achieve relatively high accuracy, and the mean absolute error (MAE) obtained by comparing with the real data is basically the same. Compared to the previous MAE without BDS satellite data.

articleTitle: Customer Churn Prediction in Bank Based on Different Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the rise of internet finance, the competition in the banking industry has become increasingly fierce. Preventing the loss of customers and retaining old customers has become an important concern of major banks. Firstly, according to an existing open dataset, this paper makes a descriptive statistical analysis of each feature, and uses Logistic, Random Forest and Scv models to predict customer churn, such as AUC curves, Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), and Mean Absolute Error (MSE). The better-performing models listed above are then chosen. Finally, Svm is selected as the best performance model, and according to descriptive statistics and feature importance, some suggestions are put forward for banks to retain customers.

articleTitle: Base station siting optimization based on greedy and simulated annealing algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In this paper, we establish an optimization model based on the greedy algorithm and simulated annealing algorithm to provide a reference for network operators and base station planners to select sites for 5G network base stations, and establish a transitive clustering model based on chunking idea and concurrent set for larger data volume. In this paper, under the constraint that the distance between new base stations and between old and new base stations is greater than 10, the service coverage is taken as the first optimization objective and the base station construction cost is taken as the second optimization objective, and the construction cost is taken as the first optimization objective after the service coverage reaches 90%. Based on the idea of the greedy algorithm, we calculate the “cost performance” of the optional base station coordinates under the establishment of two types of base stations, macro, and micro. On this basis, the formula for determining whether a weak coverage point is covered by a BTS is adjusted, and the angle constraints of three sectors are newly added, and the simulated annealing algorithm is used to randomly adjust the angle of three sectors of some BTSs at each iteration. The model-derived BTS siting scheme can cover 90% of the total service volume of the weak coverage point.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Most Promising Motor Technology in Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper discusses about the relative analysis of induction machine (1M), reluctance machine (RM) and permanent-magnet machine (PMM) and determines the most promising machine for electric vehicle (EV) traction. Recently, environmental issues, such as global warming, have aroused broad concern, which boosts the development of electric vehicles and electric motor machines. The history and electric drive system are briefly introduced. Then, the details of electric machine classification are illustrated. After that, the merits and demerits of the three machines are analyzed individually based on their structures and working principles. To determine the most suitable machine for electric vehicle (EV) traction, several characteristics, such as torque density, power density, efficiency, cost and torque ripple, are considered, and 1M, RM and PMM are quantitatively compared according to these characteristics. The results show that 1M is the most widely applicated motor machine in EV s while IPM is currently the most promising motor machine. However, motor machines still face many challenges, such as solving high-frequency effects and developing new topologies.

articleTitle: E-commerce Platform Risk Identification Using AHP Hierarchical Analysis and BPNN Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Artificial intelligence and machine learning are widely used in risk identification. Cross-border e-commerce platforms have increasingly become the best channel for global consumers to make purchases; however, with the surge in orders comes the risk of online purchases. Extensive quantitative data was collected through surveys and used for correlational studies that identify eight major risk factors, which are sales risk, cash/capital flow risk, market risk, customs clearance risk, shipping and delivery risk, environmental risk, logistics risk, and return risk. We then rated three online e-commerce platforms-Amazon, Ebay and Shopify-using AHP hierarchical analysis. The large number of survey responses collected, combined with the AHP scoring matrix we constructed, led to the conclusion that Shopify's online shopping risk is largest, followed by Ebay and Amazon. Based on this, we further establish and utilize BPNN neural network to predict the risk level of each website. The results show that the neural network trained in this paper has high accuracy and can be used for international e-commerce platform risk identification and evaluation.

articleTitle: Three-Dimensional Display and Exploration of the Optimization Scheme of Primary Cable Laying in Substations
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In this paper, a soil resistivity calculation model is constructed by combining the 110kV substation example soil resistivity improvement project example. According to the concept of 3D design guiding construction, this paper carries out the secondary development of the 3D design platform, and realizes the visual design of the secondary equipment wiring, transmission path and secondary virtual circuit. At the same time, this paper uses the visualization function of the software to simulate and analyze the cable construction, and uses the principle of ant colony algorithm to calculate the shortest path in the cable laying process. Finally, this paper simulates and analyzes the soil resistance value of the grounding grid and verifies it in the engineering construction. The study found that the use of 3D information model can greatly improve the design quality and design efficiency, and reduce the economic loss caused by design changes.

articleTitle: Method of grounding grid detection signal filtering
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper studies a filtering method for grounding grid detection signals, which includes: burying three-electrode sensors near the grounding grid; establishing a wavelet transform filtering model, substituting the collected data into the model, and performing wavelet multi-scale analysis on the detection data, determine the type of electromagnetic interference existing in the detection data; select the appropriate threshold value and substitute it into the wavelet transform filtering model, reconstruct the detection data, and obtain the detection data after filtering the electromagnetic interference; establish a Kalman filter model, and process the The detected data is substituted into the Kalman filter model for analysis; the type of Gaussian white noise existing in the detected data is judged; the appropriate adaptive factor is selected to further construct an adaptive Kalman filter model, and the Gaussian white noise existing in the detected data will be Filtering is performed to finally obtain detection data with completely filtered interference, which solves the problem of low accuracy of detection data in the prior art.

articleTitle: Research on Building BIM Intelligent Training System Based on Computer 3D Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In this paper, based on the BIM model of computer 3D technology and OPC standard, the research on building intelligent information integration platform is carried out. This paper uses the OPC intelligent data access technology and the characteristics of BIM 3D model information sharing. This paper innovatively adds building intelligent information to the BIM model and studies the expression, sharing and transmission of intelligent information based on BIM. In this system, facilities, tools, information, data, services, etc. can be shared and exchanged through the sharing platform. The results show that the integrated building facility management system based on BIM realizes the integration and unified application of traditional building facility management, property management and building intelligent management. The system applies BIM technology to describe architectural objects with the characteristics of standardization and visualization. The system is a further optimization and upgrade of the building facility management system.

articleTitle: Power supply structure optimization and emission reduction potential in power industry based on system dynamics
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In this paper, we construct a coupled model of the electricity market and the carbon market to explore the influence mechanisms and coupling effects of carbon emissions trading (CET) on the electricity market based on system dynamics. The model includes three subsystems: carbon emission trading, electricity market trading, and power producer investment and construction. Results indicate that introducing a carbon market can suppress thermal power's installed capacity and encourage renewable energy development. In general, the more mature the carbon market becomes, the more effective it will be at optimizing power supply structures and reducing emissions.

articleTitle: Research on Quantum Communication Technology Based on Markov's Quantum Diffusion
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In recent years, quantum communication technology has received widespread attention from the scientific community, and quantum information science technology is one of the key R&D communication technology projects and has been deeply studied. In this process, quantum spin and diffusion attenuation are the important indicators that affect the quality of quantum communication technology. Therefore, it is necessary to study its mechanism in detail to ensure that quantum communication can be carried out effectively. This article is based on the Markov chain, the related mechanism of quantum diffusion, and related research on quantum self-rotation characteristics. It is combined with quantum communication technology based on this to study how to improve the quantum communication system's reliability and stability, enhancing the system's quantum communication capabilities greatly.

articleTitle: Safety Monitoring System of South- to-North Water Diversion Construction Project Based on Big-data
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In South-to-North Water Diversion construction project, there are many sites with long lines, wide range and complex construction environment; the number of equipment, facilities and hazard sources are large, type of hazards varies, change of operators is frequent. Construction accidents are prone to occur, and safety control is difficult because of various accidents factors. Accident factors and their correlations are analyzed from aspects of construction staff, equipment, management and environment. Based on big data and other technologies, architecture of safety monitoring system for construction of South-to-North water diversion project is proposed, and technology framework of hierarchical progressive safety evaluation and classification is presented. Approach for anomaly recognition and safety evaluation modeling is also presented in detail. The study provides important technical support for improving skills of hazards identification and safety assessment in South-to-North Water Diversion projects, which enhances ability of dynamic evaluation and classification of risks in construction projects. The proposed technologies and methods help to accurate analysis of construction risks, early warning and prevention and control measures. It provides strong technical support for effective improvement in construction analysis ability and safety management level, which help to reduce construction accidents.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional Image and Terrain Matching Based on Interferometric Synthetic Aperture Radar Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In recent years, due to underground resource extraction and underground space construction, the internal structure of the ground strata has been seriously damaged, leading to frequent disasters such as road collapse, bridge collapse and landslide, which pose serious threats to people's lives and safety. In order to improve the spatial resolution and deformation measurement accuracy, this paper also adopts the interferometric synthetic aperture radar (InSAR) technology to match the image with the topographic data in three dimensions by geometric mapping, and the organic combination of the two technologies with complementary advantages greatly improves the accuracy and reliability of surface deformation data in the monitoring area. Finally, the measured results are analyzed by comparing whether the difference of coordinate changes at the same point in a short period of time exceeds the threshold value for disaster pre-disaster judgment, and disaster prediction is made by wireless network or Beidou short message function. Several sets of experimental results show that the measurement accuracy of deformation in the horizontal direction of the ground surface is better than 3 mm and the measurement accuracy of elevation settlement deformation is better than 5 mm by using the method of this paper, which greatly improves the accuracy and reliability of deformation monitoring.

articleTitle: Cards and structured process planning based on Teamcenter
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The traditional process design method generally uses independent cards to record process information. It usually uses document editing software to compile all process information manually, which has problems such as low efficiency, high error rate and data redundancy. To reduce or avoid these problems, enterprises use structured process design instead of traditional process design. The Siemens Teamcenter system provides a structured process design environment. This paper mainly uses the Manufacturing Process Planner (MPP) module and Business Modeler Integrated Development Environment (BMIDE) module in Teamcenter software, as well as the Word software plug-in, combined with the corresponding configuration and development means, to achieve the card structured process design of processes and steps. This method improves the design efficiency of engineers, saves design time, and improves the manufacturing level of enterprises.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of structural health monitoring system for umbilical tower
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Structural health monitoring technology is a research hotspot in aerospace engineering and other fields. The establishment of structural health monitoring system for umbilical tower can provide basis and guidance for its structural maintenance and management decision-making. Based on the umbilical tower structure health monitoring system under construction, this paper focuses on some key technologies of the application of fiber Bragg grating in the umbilical tower structure health monitoring, and completes the construction of the system hardware platform and the design and development of related data analysis and processing software. The results show that the sensor network system based on Fiber Bragg grating is a monitoring system suitable for the safe operation and evaluation of umbilical tower structure.

articleTitle: IS-Net: Improved Ship Detector Based on RetinaNet
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Ship detection has important practical significance in military and livelihood fields, and the rapid identification and accurate positioning of ships help monitor maritime traffic, thus ensuring maritime navigation safety and safeguarding national maritime rights and interests. However, in practical scenarios, the arrangement of ships mostly has the characteristics of dense and different directions, which makes the horizontal frame detection no longer applicable to ship detection. Therefore, in this paper, we use an improved rotating frame detection network based on RetinaNet, named IS-net. In order to fully extract ship features to improve detection accuracy, the ConvNext network is used as the backbone network. In addition, we use Kullback-Leibler Divergence (KLD) as the regression loss. KLD (and its derivative) can dynamically adjust the parameter gradient according to the characteristics of the object, which makes the regression effect more accurate. In this paper, we use the well-known HRSC2016 dataset, and a large number of ablation experiments show that IS-net has excellent detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Big Data among Multiple Institutions Based on DAG Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The transparency and reliability, tamper resistance, traceability, etc. of blockchain technology enable it to protect privacy and share information. The purpose of this paper is to study the secure sharing method of big data among multiple institutions based on the DAG blockchain. This paper analyzes the development of big data and the importance of big data security sharing, as well as the shortcomings of existing security sharing schemes, introduces some theoretical basic knowledge used in the design of this paper, and introduces the big data security sharing scheme based on DAG blockchain. It includes three parts: the scheme architecture of GCP-ABE, the design of DAG block structure and the design of attribute encryption algorithm. The processing steps of encrypted files are described, and the computational cost of the GCP-ABE scheme is compared with the existing big data security sharing schemes through simulation experiments to prove that the scheme in this paper has good performance and functional advantages.

articleTitle: Prediction and Data Analysis of Price Based on PSO with Extreme Learning Machine Algorithm and Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The changes in the trading market are affected by many factors, and traditional forecasting methods are more and more difficult to meet people's needs. In order to improve the accuracy of prediction, this paper proposes an extreme learning machine algorithm based on particle swarm optimization for prediction and analysis. First, the fluctuation data of previous years are collected, and the closing price of the stock is determined as an experiment and simulated to establish a learning sample, and then the learning sample is input. Based on the online extreme learning machine model optimized by particle swarm optimization, the prediction model is established. The results show that the optimized extreme learning machine algorithm, compared with models such as ELM, PSO-BP and DE-ELM, has better surface prediction accuracy and fitting effect, and can more accurately describe the change trend, which is more efficient than other methods.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Blind Glasses System Based on Stair & Step Recognition Function
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In this paper, an intelligent blind glasses system based on stair & step recognition is proposed, which combines the innovative appearance of the product and the high performance advantages of functional modules to effectively assist visually impaired users to safely avoid obstacles when they encounter stairs or steps in indoor environments.

articleTitle: Research on artificial intelligence logistics distribution route management system based on computer information technology
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper introduces two shortest path algorithms under computer information technology, and introduces some applications of them in logistics management. Dijkstra algorithm and Floyd algorithm are used to solve the distribution path problem in logistics management, and compare the two algorithms. In order to ensure that in the future practice, the fit, adaptability and compatibility of artificial intelligence technology (AI) can be reasonably developed, so as to provide technical support for optimizing the network structure and enhancing the network operation effect. Combined with the current situation and needs of data analysis of logistics enterprises, it provides decision support for logistics enterprises to improve logistics marketing services and optimize logistics routes.

articleTitle: Simulation of E-business User Interest Mining Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: E-business websites provide users with more and more choices. At the same time, under the massive commodity information, users often lose themselves and cannot find the commodities they need. In the increasingly fierce competition of e-business, personalized recommendation system is increasingly sought after by enterprises and has become an important field of e-business research. In this paper, the technology of big data processing based on cloud computing is used to study the implementation technology of e-business intelligent recommendation algorithm and the comprehensive evaluation method of recommendation system in big data environment, and an e-business user interest mining model is constructed to meet the personalized intelligent recommendation requirements of e-business in big data environment. The results show that the error of the proposed user data mining algorithm is small, and the accuracy rate is high, reaching 96.85%. It is of great theoretical significance and economic value to study the intelligent recommendation system of e-business based on cloud computing technology to improve the effectiveness, scale and real-time of personalized recommendation system of e-business and enhance the level of personalized precision marketing.

articleTitle: Research on multi-scenario crowd density monitoring and management system based on Beidou technology
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In recent years, the state has vigorously promoted the development of tourism and service industries. At the same time, public security incidents have occurred frequently due to excessive crowd density. Therefore, it is necessary to establish a multi-scenario crowd density monitoring and management system. In this regard, this paper proposes a multi-scenario crowd density monitoring and management system based on Beidou technology, so that managers can formulate scientific crowd control measures. The system consists of three parts: intelligent car, server and user. The smart car moves in a certain area according to the specified trajectory or autonomous navigation. At the collection point, the OpenMV module carried on the car uses the Haar operator to realize face detection. The face detection works by using the Haar Cascade feature detector on the image. Haar Cascades runs very fast, and can be better applied to face detection in the case of people walking. It counts the number of detected faces, and the acquired number is transmitted to the motherboard and the short message sent by the GPS Beidou dual-mode positioning module. The text is sent to the server. The server side processes the number of people and location information received from the trolley. In special circumstances, the trolley can be remotely controlled through the WFI module, which is convenient for viewing at the place where the accident occurred. The client performs system settings on the server to obtain the required information. This system is based on Beidou technology, which helps decision makers to manage the flow of people to a great extent.

articleTitle: Research on steel tube fatigue experiment technology based on Butterworth filter method
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Duplex stainless steel tube is an important component of subsea umbilical, providing hydraulic, chemical and other injection channels for subsea production system equipment. Duplex stainless steel tube is transported by reel, which will produce plastic deformation and have large impact on its fatigue properties. There are lot of noisy during the test. Therefore, this paper studied the Butterworth filter method to process signals and the fatigue properties of duplex stainless steel tube after transport by reel, and get more accurate filtered signals, compares it with the S-N curve of small diameter steel tube in DNV-RP-C203 to analyze the fatigue properties of plastic deformed steel tube, and the results show that the fatigue properties of steel tube after transport by reel have slight attenuation.

articleTitle: Study on influence of atmospheric turbulence over sea on laser communication between the ships
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Atmospheric turbulence near the sea surface has an important impact on ship laser communication. This paper deduces a theoretical model suitable to describing the signal-to-noise ratio and bit error rate under strong and weak turbulence based on the atmospheric turbulence theory of Kolmogorov and Rytov, and conducts numerical simulations with the physical conditions of ship communication in mind. It finally puts forward measures to improve the communication quality after an analysis of how atmospheric turbulence influences the performance indicators of laser communication with different wavelengths.

articleTitle: The Research of Standard Model's RCS Calculation and its Analytical Efficiency Based on FASTEM-STUDIO
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: CST has high-performance 3D electromagnetic analysis software package, which used for design, analysis and optimization of electromagnetic components and systems. It is a simulator based on the finite integral method of time domain electromagnetic field solution algorithm, which is suitable for the simulation of broadband spectrum result. As for FASTEM, it is a special simulation software for the calculation and diagnostic analysis of electromagnetic characteristics of targets. FASTEM can also calculate the electromagnetic scattering characteristics of complex targets such as aircraft, missiles, satellites, vehicles and ships, and obtain the scattering characteristics data of the complex targets under the conditions of full band, full space and full polarization. In this paper, the scattering characteristics of several typical targets were calculated by CST and FASTEM, and the effectiveness of FASTEM can be illustrated by comparing the results. Through the above calculation and research, a set of reasonable and feasible analytical efficiency comparative analysis content of CST and FASTEM is put forward in final.

articleTitle: Blockchain Data Privacy Protection Method Based on Intelligent Collaborative Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the increasing maturity of blockchain technology, more and more systems use blockchain as the underlying architecture. And the ever-increasing number of loT devices also generate massive amounts of data. There is no doubt that these data will generate greater data value when they are collaboratively processed and shared. Considering that these data belong to different entities or individuals, using secure multi-party computing to design a data processing and sharing scheme can well take into account the two requirements of data security and privacy protection. The main purpose of this paper is to conduct research on blockchain data privacy protection methods based on intelligent collaborative computing. Based on Paillier algorithm, this paper optimizes its decryption process and reduces the decryption time of the homomorphic encryption process. In the experiment of testing the algorithm scheme, the experimental results show that the key generation time of various key lengths is tested for the proposed scheme, and the results show that the key generation time increases almost linearly with the increase of the key length.

articleTitle: Research and application of BIM based bridge operation health monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Based on a cable-stayed bridge in Chengdu, a health monitoring system based on bridge operation period is established in this paper. By combining BM with traditional health monitoring technology, the 3d model of the monitoring system is visualized. Through the establishment of acquisition and transmission module, real-time data collection is realized. Intelligent analysis and preprocessing of massive monitoring data are realized by virtual server and system self-diagnosis technology deployed in cloud computing center. Through the multi-platform display and video linkage technology of the system, especially the development of mobile APP software, the bridge manager can get real-time safety warning and master the operation status of the structure at any time. Through the statistical analysis of singularity rate and missing rate of massive monitoring data, as well as the early warning of overload event, the system is verified to be in good running state, the monitoring data is reliable and the safety early warning is efficient.

articleTitle: Analysis of e-commerce customer data mining based on Apriori optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the rapid development, the Internet has gained great popularity. As a new way of sales, e-commerce has rapidly occupied a large proportion of China's retail industry. E-commerce has opened up new markets and new ways of shopping. The algorithm based on association rules in this paper uses Apriori algorithm to recommend products to users, which saves users' shopping time and attracts more users. In this paper, Apriori algorithm is briefly introduced, and an improved method is proposed, and the improved algorithm is simply verified. It is beneficial for enterprises to accurately identify customer needs, take timely actions, and comprehensively carry out precise marketing, thus increasing market share. After fully developing customer needs and carrying out precise marketing, we should also pay attention to the maintenance of customer relationship. Combining theory with practice, on the basis of analysis, we can extract and discover customer needs from a lot of information, so as to implement precise marketing strategies and even create customer needs.

articleTitle: Analysis of Active Directional Acoustic Energy Propagation Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Active directional acoustic energy is a key indicator that affects the effectiveness of non-lethal sonic weapons. It is easily affected by marine environmental factors and reduces the active acoustic energy range. In this paper, combined with the actual marine environmental factors and ship motion state, from the propagation characteristics of active directional acoustic energy are analyzed in terms of establishing the acoustic signal model of directional acoustic energy, refraction, reflection and correction of acoustic signals, and attenuation characteristics of acoustic signals. The influence of tactical parameters such as directivity provides a theoretical basis for further improving the performance of shipborne sonic weapons, improving their structural design, and flexible tactical applications.

articleTitle: Analysis of Data Mining Mode of Customer Consumption Behavior Based on Fuzzy Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The purpose of studying the consumer behavior of enterprise customers is to maintain a long-term exchange relationship with customers, and to facilitate the formulation of corresponding marketing strategies. This paper focuses on the research of customer's consumption behavior, compares the advantages and disadvantages of current related algorithms on customer's consumption behavior, and finally chooses fuzzy clustering algorithm for customer segmentation research, uses association rules based on changes of customer's consumption behavior pattern to build a prediction model, and deeply understands these algorithms, and puts forward corresponding improvements aiming at the shortcomings of the algorithms. Finally, it is verified by experiments that the average relative error and root mean square error of the prediction system before and after the improvement are low, but it can be clearly seen that the improved prediction system has smaller error than the traditional system, indicating that the improved prediction system has higher prediction accuracy. Clustering algorithm in DM(data mining) technology is used to segment customers. The selection of methods and attributes is the decisive factor for the effectiveness of clustering algorithm. It can be said that these two aspects are crucial factors for all DM methods.

articleTitle: Evaluation method of wireless network communication anti-jamming performance based on rough set
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The transmission signal of large-scale multi-input multi-output wireless network facing medium and high frequency de-cellular is interfered by the intersymbol fluctuation of spectrum disturbance noise, which leads to the distortion of the output error code in the far-field and near-field areas of antenna array, so it is necessary to carry out anti-interference filtering processing of wireless network communication. This paper proposes a filtering technology of communication interference signal in medium and high frequency de-cellular large-scale multi-input multi-output wireless network based on rough set spectrum parameter estimation. Extract that characteristic quantity of the output signal of the medium-high frequency cellular large-scale MIMO wireless network, using sparse Bayesian learn and rough set estimation method of channel parameters to enhance the line spectrum of the communication signal of the medium-high frequency cellular large-scale MIMO wireless network, and extracting the rough vector characteristic matching set of the communication transmission signal of the medium-high frequency cellular large-scale MIMO wireless network by combine the array antenna correlation matching method, Block sparse Bayesian learning is used to decompose the spectrum of the signal, and the posterior probability estimation method of the channel vector is used to decompose the feature and separate the blind source of the extracted interference signal, so as to realize the effective filtering and immunity evaluation of the interference signal in the large-scale multi-input multi-output wireless network with medium and high frequency de-cellular. The simulation results show that the filtering performance of communication interference signals in large-scale multi-input multi-output wireless network with medium and high frequency de-cellular is good, the signal-to-noise ratio of output signals is high, and the signal fidelity and anti-interference evaluation ability of large-scale multi-input multi-output wireless network transmission are improved.

articleTitle: Asymptotic Compactness Control for a Class of Nonhomemade Systems with Supercritical Conditions
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: By means of operator decomposition, the solution operator is decomposed into compact and asymptotically small parts, and truncation function or weighting function is used to prove that the solution is uniformly small for large space and time variables. The asymptotic compactness is proved by means of energy perturbation and the solution operator is decomposed into compact and asymptotically small parts by means of operator decomposition.

articleTitle: Stock price prediction based on ARIMA-PCA-BP hybrid model
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Stock price prediction has important practical significance and has always been a hot topic. Stock prices are affected by a variety of different factors and are highly dimensional and nonlinear, which makes forecasting difficult. Common stock price prediction models include statistical prediction models and machine learning models. However, the statistical prediction models lack the consideration of nonlinear information. Moreover, the information redundancy of stock price factors will reduce the learning rate of neural network. These defects can reduce the accuracy of prediction. In order to improve the prediction accuracy of stock price, this paper proposes a hybrid model based on autoregressive integrated moving average (ARIMA) and back propagation (BP) neural network, and the BP neural network is optimized by principal component analysis (PCA) algorithm. The empirical analysis of 5 stocks in different industries is carried out. The results show that compared with the single ARIMA model or BP neural network model, the ARIMA-PCA-BP hybrid model improves the prediction accuracy of stock prices and has good learning ability and generalization ability.

articleTitle: Automatic tracking intelligent car based on image processing
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Abstarct-N ow the car has become an essential tool for people to travel, but driving a car is still a skill. The safety and reliability of automobile driving also has a great relationship with the driver's state. In addition, because of the incomplete controllability of man-made driving route and speed, traffic congestion has become an important problem in cities. It is imperative to solve these problems by means of science and technology, and driverless technology has emerged as the times require. The automatic-tracking smart car we study is an attempt to study driverless technology. In this car, gray-scale camera is used as the main sensor, and gyroscope is used as the auxiliary sensor, and PID algorithm is used to realize automatic tracking and special element recognition.

articleTitle: Analysis of airport construction project cost management based on Big data perspective
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the rapid development of communication and information technology led by 5G technology, big data technology is playing an increasingly significant role in today's society with the development of 5G communication technology. As an important part of social and economic development and construction, airport construction project has some room for improvement in project cost management due to extensive and wasteful problems in traditional project management. This paper analyzes the cost management of airport construction project from the perspective of big data technology and puts forward suggestions, hoping to make contributions to the development of airport construction industry.

articleTitle: Research on Traffic Picture Recognition Method Based on Multi-scale Feature Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Since the rapid development of deep learning technology, traffic picture recognition technology has been significantly enhanced. In the process of recognizing complex traffic pictures, errors are likely to occur. Our objective is to improve the efficiency of the algorithm and the characteristics of the neural network, as well as to utilize the characteristics of stereo image analysis to conduct in-depth research on road conditions pictures based on multi-scale feature algorithms. The aim of this paper is to investigate in detail the process of image recognition and reconstruction using the multi-scale feature algorithm. Furthermore, we derive its loss function, which significantly improves its running characteristics.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Industrial IoT Device Management System Based on 5G Communication and Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The intelligent upgrade of manufacturing industry makes the IoT devices in factories and workshops increase dramatically, the data types and data structures of transmitted data become more and more complex, and the increase of intelligence makes factories urgently need a communication method with low latency, high bandwidth and large connection on the one hand, on the other hand, the traditional data storage and processing methods are gradually difficult to handle the rapidly increasing number and complex structure of IoT devices. The system is based on NB-IoT communication module and Hadoop big data platform, which can effectively realize the intelligent transformation of equipment and upgrade of data storage and processing methods in workshops and factories. The system has practical value in improving manufacturing production efficiency and reducing factory management costs, and has some reference significance for other industries to carry out intelligent transformation.

articleTitle: Human Failure Analysis in ATC Anti-collision Based on Modified CREAM Method
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In order to improve the reliability of people in collision avoidance work and minimize the impact of human failure on collision avoidance work, this paper uses the cognitive reliability and error analysis method ( CREAM ) to analyze the accident case, and combines the uncertainty theory to establish a collision avoidance human failure analysis model. This method first uses CREAM to analyze the accident case, identify the failure mode and predict the probability of failure. Then, the uncertainty theory is used to process the expert data, correct the failure probability obtained by CREAM, and evaluate the reliability of human in the accident. The example analysis of air collision accidents with air traffic controllers as the main body shows that this method can quantitatively evaluate the reliability of people in collision avoidance tasks. The procedure is rigorous, the operability is good, and the result is credible.

articleTitle: Defect Recognition in Ultrasonic Blind Zone Based on Hilbert Marginal Spectrum
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In the ultrasonic defect detection of metal, the small defect signals near the surface are submerged in the surface or bottom echo signals, and there is a blind zone of defect detection. To solve this problem, a method based on Hilbert marginal spectrum is proposed to identify metal near surface defects. Hilbert-Huang transform is used to analyze ultrasonic signals and eliminate the interference of non-stationary signals. The feature signal is integrated on the time axis to obtain the actual frequency distribution of the signal to identify the defects, and support vector machine (SVM) is used for cross experiment verification. The near surface micro defects were identified by 304 stainless steel test block. The results show that the Hilbert-Huang transform can effectively extract the features of ultrasonic signals and reduce the influence of blind areas. The average accuracy of defect identification using Hilbert marginal spectrum is 98.94%, which provides a new method for identifying small defects near the surface of metal.

articleTitle: Optimization of Dynamic Time Slot Allocation of Digital Resources in Communication Network Based on Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: At present, the communication network mainly adopts two structural forms: the centerless end-to-end structure and the “base station-user terminal” structure. The two structures are mainly distinguished by whether there is a central node or not. This leads to the huge differences between the two networks. Reasonable allocation of time slots to nodes is an effective technique to optimize channel allocation, and it improves the capacity of network system, thus achieving great success in civil communication. The research shows that the ACA(Ant colony algorithm) proposed in this paper effectively controls the time delay, and the time delay is reduced by about 8.9%. This is mainly because the algorithm in this paper allocates time slots according to routing information, which shortens the waiting time of nodes in the process of allocating time slots. Routing tree takes the sink as the root node, and each node gives priority to the parent node or child node in the same tree to allocate time slots. The test results based on ACA can realize the accurate allocation of time slot resources in the communication network, improve the communication quality and throughput of the communication network, and improve the problem that the time slot resources in the communication network cannot be evenly allocated.

articleTitle: Construction of Building Information Management System Based on Grid 3D Building Model
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the climax of the global information revolution, the knowledge economy and sustainable development have attracted wide attention. The purpose of this paper is to make full use of modern electronic information technology, computer technology and communication technology to realize information sharing and unified management of intelligent buildings. Reduce the number of managers, improve management efficiency and reduce the quality requirements for managers. Using the enhanced 3D point cloud model, the image boundary line is converted into spatial boundary line, and the spatial boundary line is closed, so as to obtain more accurate characteristic boundary line. In this paper, firstly, the point with small curvature change between the planes around the vertex is selected, and then it is merged with its adj acent vertices. This method of vectorization simplification according to grid direction is equivalent to adding error discrimination method on the basis of shortest edge first simplification. By using Internet/Intranet, Web services and other technologies and SOA design framework, this paper proposes a building information management system based on grid 3D building model.
