The test data show that our algorithm has a great improvement in controlling the geometric error of simplification, which is about 6.81 % higher than the comparison, especially when the degree of simplification is large, the effect is more obvious.

articleTitle: Design Optimization of Integrated Energy System Using Virtual Energy Storage under the Use of K-means Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Sustainable development has become the current consensus of all countries, and one after another has established an integrated energy system (IES) of virtual energy storage. The optimization of the system is the most crucial problem now. This work aims to optimize the energy system by improving the K-means clustering algorithm. It introduces the K-means clustering algorithm, the Dijkstra algorithm, and the virtual energy storage features of electric heating IES. Next, the K-means clustering algorithm is optimized by introducing the Dijkstra algorithm into it. On the one hand, the K-means clustering algorithm is not suitable for attribute problems with large values. On the other hand, the primary cluster center and outliers are optimized. Eventually, the rationality and effectiveness of the optimized algorithm are validated through comparative experiments. The experimental results show that the optimization algorithm will more accurately compare elements within the class. Moreover, by comparing intra-class differences and inter-class differences, the optimized K-means clustering algorithm cluster will be more compact and the corresponding clustering quality will be higher. This work has certain reference significance for the optimization of the IES of virtual energy storage.

articleTitle: Nitrogen Dioxide Sensor Calibration Based on Local Linear Model
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of nitrogen dioxide sensor, a locally weighted linear regression model was introduced to establish a locally weighted linear regression prediction model. The model first sets the weight of temperature and humidity of each part through the kernel function to generate a new data set. Secondly, a locally weighted linear regression model for nitrogen dioxide concentration was established by least square linear fitting regression for the new data set. Finally, the nitrogen dioxide sensor is corrected and predicted according to the model. Compared with the traditional linear regression prediction model, the experimental results show that the proposed method is effective and provides a new method for sensor calibration.

articleTitle: Analysis of Blind Box Consumption Data and Marketing Strategy Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the development of Internet technology and the rise of fan economy, blind boxes have become an indispensable part of young people's lives. In recent years, blind box has become a popular economic phenomenon, and “blind box economy” has emerged. Blind box consumption has established a high degree of customer stickiness and brand dependence through the combination of accurate consumer groups in the early stage, in-depth development of IP resources and horizontal wide fields in the middle stage, and carefully planned marketing activities in the later stage. In this paper, we use the MapReduce programming of Hadoop cluster to implement improved genetic algorithm, which is used to quickly and accurately find the goods that best meet customer needs in the n-dimensional commodity space. The experimental results show that the improved genetic algorithm has an average increase of 15.6% in recommendation accuracy and 41.9% in recommendation response time compared with the traditional genetic algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Quantum Machine Learning Technology Based on Regenerating Kernel Hilbert Space
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In the era of big data, software algorithms are improving rapidly, and machine learning algorithms are also widely used. In doing so, transmitting signals from quantum devices will also contribute to research on machine learning technology. Traditional machine learning networks face the problem of low efficiency and slow response when processing large amounts of complex data. Quantum computing technology offers supercomputing power to compensate for this shortcoming. Based on the advanced development of quantum machine learning and quantum computing technology, this paper combines machine learning technology. Integrate the regenerated kernel Hilbert space to complete the composition of the architecture, effectively improving the computational performance of machine learning.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of Mine Ventilation System Based on Wind Network Approximate Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Mining is a continuous process of continuous change and development, and mine ventilation systems are an important part of the process. Mining is a continuous process of continuous change and development, and mine ventilation systems are an important part of the process. Additionally, the mining process is constantly evolving and innovating. Despite the improvements in technology, there are still some problems with the current mine ventilation system, including its hardware structure and design control. It is necessary to improve and solve these problems. An approximate optimization algorithm is used to improve the ventilation pipes and air network in the mine ventilation system to solve the problem of the unreasonable ventilation system design. It is also designed to meet the corresponding requirements in terms of return air section resistance and air supply route resistance. Efforts are made to improve the mine ventilation system's performance, and the system's main air supply branches are optimized to increase their efficiency.

articleTitle: DyMAP: Defeating SGX Controlled Channel Attacks with Dynamic Memory Access Patterns
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: SGX controlled channel attacks is a method to steal the data inside the enclave. To defeat it, this paper present a novel method to develop the software with a dynamic memory access pattern which is called as DyMAP which is abbreviation of Dynamic Memory Access Patterns. DyMAP is able to dynamically assign control data at runtime, so that the software change its control flow every time it runs, thus breaking the static mapping relationship between control flow and data flow, which greatly increases the difficulty of SGX side channel analysis. Our tests shows that DyMAP is capable of defeating SGX controlled channel attacks with a acceptable overhead.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of Spatial-Temporal Relationship and Risk Evolution of Emergencies Based on Big Data from Social Media
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: There are many kinds of emergencies in the real world, and there is a close connection between different events. However, the current research on the evolution of emergency risk is limited by the volume and period of the data, which makes the conclusions drawn from these studies have certain limitations today. To describe the emergency's temporal and spatial distribution and its casual emergency chain from the perspective of statistics, we obtain a large amount of data in terms of emergency from Sina Weibo, one of the most famous social media in China. The research outcome is expected to contribute to early warning for preventing and controlling emergencies by fully using accumulated, updated, and rich emergency data from social media.

articleTitle: Application of a New Digital Twin Model in Infrastructure Construction
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In response to the construction surge of “ultra-high voltage” in new infrastructure, digital twin technology has been applied and developed unprecedentedly in power system. The paper firstly introduces the concepts of new infrastructure and digital twin technology, and reveals that building a digital twin model is the core requirement of new infrastructure. In view of the problems of the current traditional digital twin system in power systems, a lightweight digital twin model based on the digital-model separation data flow method is proposed, and the technical methods used in the model are elaborated. Finally, it introduces the pilot construction scheme based on this digital twin model in the 500 kV substation intelligent monitoring platform and the implementation of scenarios under the model application. The results show that the technical model proposed in this paper has significant effect in practical engineering and provides important reference significance for the future development of power systems.

articleTitle: Research on Data Processing of Operational Effectiveness Evaluation of Tactical Missile Weapon System Based on Energy Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: As a key weapon to strike accurately and seize air superiority, tactical weapon system requires higher and higher operational efficiency. The effectiveness evaluation of missile system can not only provide a quantitative basis for the upgrading of missile weapons, but also provide criteria for judging the effectiveness of missile weapons in combat exercises. In the process of research, based on energy analysis and according to the characteristics of missile weapon system, an index system for evaluating the effectiveness of missile weapon system close to actual combat is established. With the system confrontation as the background, according to the different mastery of enemy intelligence, ADC method is adopted, which can comprehensively reflect the state of weapon system and the dynamic changes of many technical and tactical indexes changing with time in combat use. The fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method and analytic hierarchy process are used to qualitatively analyze the capability matrix in ADC model and quantitatively process the data. The correctness and effectiveness of the evaluation model are verified by an example.

articleTitle: Research and application of computer vision in the field of construction progress control
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Project schedule lag is a problem often faced in engineering projects, and it is also an important reason for project cost overruns. It is of great significance to study the identification method of construction project image progress for monitoring and controlling project progress. The current project progress management mostly relies on manual inspection to collect on-site progress information, which is not only time-consuming and labor-intensive, but also the feedback of progress information is not timely. Therefore, this paper uses computer vision, deep learning and other technologies, combined with the logical reasoning of finite state machines, to study the identification method of construction project image progress at the construction process level.

articleTitle: Construction of Safe Transmission Model of Industrial Control Data Information in Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The data information interaction between industrial control devices is frequent. Under the invasion of criminals, the leakage and tampering of industrial control data information occur frequently, which threatens the safety of industrial control data information transmission. Therefore, this paper puts forward a research on the construction of industrial control data information security transmission model of industrial Internet of Things. This paper analyzes the security vulnerabilities of MQTT (Industrial Internet of Things Communication Protocol), determines that the security transmission threats of industrial control data are data theft and man-in-the-middle attack, and explores the principle of industrial control data transmission. On this basis, TLS is used to encrypt the process of industrial control data transmission, and SEMA-E2C protocol is used to accurately authenticate the identities of both parties of industrial control data transmission, thus realizing the security transmission of industrial control data. The experimental results show that the minimum packet loss rate of industrial control data transmission obtained by using the constructed model is 3%, and the maximum safety factor of industrial control data transmission is 9.8, which proves that the constructed industrial control data transmission model is more secure.

articleTitle: Design and Experiment of Surface Shaping Robot for Precast Concrete Based on BIM
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In order to solve the rapid prefabrication of complex and irregular surface texture of precast concrete(PC), a multi degree of freedom(DOF) surface finishing robot and its end-effector are designed, and a building information model(BIM) driven robot path planning method is proposed, which realizes rapid automatic processing of PC components with irregular surface texture. Firstly, the forming mechanism of the complex irregular surface texture is discussed, and the relationship between the width of the texture and the cutting depth, the rotation angle of end-effector and other factors are analyzed. Subsequently, an off-line path planning method is formulated that can generate robot processing path from texture's BIM model directly. Finally, a prototype robot is developed to analyze the optimal processing conditions and perform some surface finishing experiments. The experimental results verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the designed robot and proposed method.

articleTitle: Analysis of Urban Social Electricity Consumption Based on Neural Network and SHAP Model
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Neural networks have been applied in analyzing the influencing factors of electricity consumption in residential households nationwide and have achieved good results in electricity consumption prediction. However, the invisibility of the decision-making process of the neural network system leads to its inability to get a good solution in explaining the influencing factors. It was found that the interpretability of BP neural network was 0.902, compared with 0.847 of FEM model, and the SHAP model gave the marginal contribution of each feature. Also, among the features affecting electricity consumption, household water consumption, retail sales of consumer goods, and education expenditure have important values for residential household electricity consumption. In this paper, we discuss the application of neural networks in the factors affecting residential household electricity consumption from the perspective of interpretability, and innovatively introduce the SHAP interpretation method to study the important indicators in the rating, which is important for the research in the field of residential household electricity consumption.
